p1_findings.title: Specifications/ folder superseded but not archived
p1_findings.summary: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md contains 76 FRs with zero implementation traceability. The active implementation is a Self-Judging Workflow Engine not covered by this spec.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Every team member and agent reads this spec as authoritative; they build toward obsolete requirements, creating permanent drift between spec and system
p1_findings.recommendation: Archive with [SUPERSEDED] header and date, or move FRs into active Plans/

p1_findings.title: 27 FR-dependency-* IDs unanchored in any spec or plan
p1_findings.summary: 27 traceability IDs in source code (FR-dependency-service, FR-dependency-picker, etc.) have no corresponding spec or plan requirements file — they are ghost references.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Traceability enforcer cannot validate these IDs; audits pass green while these paths are entirely unverified
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md with formal FR entries for all FR-dependency-* IDs

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer scope mismatch (plan-only, not spec-aware)
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan all Specifications/*.md, or document clearly that it is plan-scoped only

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call workItemStore directly — no service layer
p2_findings.recommendation: Create WorkItemService in Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts; route handlers call service only

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md 13 FRs have zero implementation
p2_findings.recommendation: Classify as active WIP or future-planned; create Plans/ entry if active

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing absent (mandatory architecture rule)
p2_findings.recommendation: Install @opentelemetry/sdk-node and add auto-instrumentation + traceparent header propagation
